18.t: Working with data: what does it cost?
q: Which appliance has the highest power?
Calculate the cost per day for the fridge.
Calculate kWh and cost per day for the rice cooker.
The fridge has a low power but costs a lot. Explain why.
It runs for 24 hours a day; energy = power × time, so a long time adds up.
Suggest the best single change to cut the bill, using the data.
Use the air conditioner less or set it 1-2 °C warmer: it uses 9.6 of 14.2 kWh a day (about two-thirds), so cutting it saves most.
